decisions.reason: The rye country bread fits the core range and uses existing manual production, so keeping the option open costs little while its demand is still being revealed.
The repeated gold medal shows realized value for this flagship stollen, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The seeded rye mixed bread is a cheap variant of established recipes with no negative signals so far, so the option stays open.
The dark malt rye bread overlaps with other rye breads, much as the dropped ancient grain bread did, but its low holding cost still justifies waiting for clearer demand evidence.
The marzipan stollen complements the award-winning stollen line seasonally at minimal cost, so the option remains open for another Christmas season.
